reason: Most of my collabs are barter, a free meal or product for a reel, so there's no rate to negotiate and no payment to chase. I might try the free version for the scam check, but I wouldn't pay for Pro or give up 5% on the few paid deals I get.
objection: My deals already come to my DMs and I just say yes to the barter ones. A tool built around counter-offers and payment reminders is solving a money problem I barely have, and I edit reels at night, I don't have time to set up another app.
would_change_my_mind: If it actually got me paid deals, showed me that brands sending barter offers would pay cash for my numbers and helped me turn a few of those into real money, then ₹199 a year would be nothing.
